title: Understanding ROC-AUC
text: The ROC-AUC (Receiver Operating Characteristic - Area Under Curve) is a performance measurement for classification problems at various thresholds settings. It tells how much the model is capable of distinguishing between classes.

title: Effect of Lowering the Threshold
text: Lowering the decision threshold means that the model will classify more instances as 'Kendrick'. This can affect the true positive rate and false positive rate.

title: Impact on ROC-AUC
text: The ROC-AUC is a measure of the model's ability to distinguish between classes, independent of the threshold. Changing the threshold does not affect the ROC-AUC value.
